method: Two local servers (old ref via git archive, current tree), key empty so no AI or news calls; all non-local requests aborted; reduced motion; Math.random seeded with mulberry32(20261021) in both versions. Normal: innerText of upcoming lists (EPL, LaLiga), club search, preview, simulation panel, report, local natural-language answer, body text and <main> outerHTML (sha256, report creation clock text masked) at list and preview, PNG bytes of list viewport / #matches preview / simulation panel / analysis result, plus MatchDeskSimulation.sample() for 641 matches x 20 seeds. Overflow = scrollWidth > documentElement.clientWidth. Load failures: request routing aborts the file, answers 404, or answers 200 without the data object. Malformed scoreGrid: predictions.js served with one changed Arsenal-Leeds grid.
